designationHistory.name: Cape Meares Migratory Bird Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the Cape Meares Migratory Bird Refuge by Executive Order 7957; it is now Cape Meares National Wildlife Refuge.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Cape Meares National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
American Presidency Project: Executive Order 7957—Establishing Cape Meares Migratory Bird Refuge (Aug 19, 1938)

review.note: EO 7957, 1938-08-19 (Franklin D. Roosevelt). Draft signer field held "Sitka Spruce", a parsing error.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Cape Meares National Wildlife Refuge, established in 1938, boasts views of nearby rocky islands, vertical coastal cliffs, and rolling headlands topped with old-growth forest dominated by Sitka Spruce and Western Hemlock.
